issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify calculateTotalPrice(Meal) should return a double (double precision), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This return-type mismatch contradicts the specification and would confuse students implementing the method to meet the exercise requirements (financial calculations with double precision).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the calculateTotalPrice method signature to return double (public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update the implementation to accumulate and return a double value (e.g., use a double sum and cast ingredient prices as needed) so it matches the problem specification and UML.
